build_model_vit: build a ViT model from ViSSL config with optimizer settings for finetuning
build_optimizer_schedulers: build optimizer and scheduler objects from ViSSL optimizer configuration
get_vit_param_depth: get layer decay depth for a ViT parameter name given number of transformer blocks
get_resnet_param_depth: get layer decay depth for a ResNet parameter name given number of residual layers
get_optimizer_param_groups: get optimizer parameter groups with layer decay learning rates and weight decay
